jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Enterprise
jobs.description:
First, What We’re Actually Doing
 
Fours (formerly Suger.io) helps revenue teams sell more effectively by simplifying the workflows required to buy and sell through cloud marketplaces. We make it easier for our customers to transact, manage, and grow deals across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba, Oracle and Snowflake, creating a smoother buying experience for their customers. We’ve grown quickly by becoming the end-to-end orchestration system for the fastest growing sales channel (B2B Cloud Marketplaces) leveraging AI and integrations with core systems.
 
Today, we’re working 300 amazing customers, ranging from enterprises like Snowflake, Workday, Intel to the top AI-native companies like the main AI labs, Decagon, Glean, etc.
 
This position will be on a hybrid model, 4 days per week in our Vancouver office at 321 Water St.

Role Overview
We're hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our growing CS team. You'll own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and driving onboarding, adoption, engagement, and retention across the full customer lifecycle.

This is a full-cycle role — you'll lead kickoff calls, manage implementations, partner closely with customers on their goals and use cases, handle day-to-day needs, and build long-term relationships with key stakeholders. You'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to ensure customers are successful and identify opportunities to expand their use of Suger.

You'll play a critical role in shaping our enterprise CS motion, balancing high-touch customer engagement with scalable processes and proactive account management.
What You'll Own
- Account Ownership

- Own a book of Enterprise accounts from kickoff through renewal

- Be the primary point of contact for your accounts via Slack and our customer ticketing system

- Drive customer health, adoption, and retention across your book of business

- Identify upsell and expansion opportunities; proactively flag at-risk accounts

- Ongoing Support & Success

- Serve as first responder for all inbound customer questions via Slack and our customer ticketing system

- Triage issues — resolve directly, loop in Product Support for bugs, or create Solutions Engineering requests in ClickUp

- Proactively introduce customers to new platform capabilities: funding portals, partner scoring, pipeline digests, automations

- Facilitate renewals and manage the renewal process in coordination with Account Management

- Maintain detailed account notes, implementation steps, and health tracking in our customer ticketing system

- Knowledge Management & Scaled CS

- Contribute to internal documentation, playbooks, and help center content

- Respond to async customer questions with clear, thorough written guidance

- Participate in team syncs, CS biweeklies, and product feedback sessions
Who We’re Looking For
- 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role — ideally in B2B SaaS or cloud

- Experience managing enterprise customers and building relationships with multiple stakeholders

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- Strong organizational and project management skills — able to manage complex customer relationships and implementations simultaneously

- Proactive and strategic in identifying customer needs, risks, and opportunities before they become issues

- Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to solve customer needs
Why join us
- Our salary range: CAD $100,000 - 120,000/year, depending on experience

- Competitive compensation and equity plan.

- Monthly office stipends for lunch and commute-related benefits

- Full healthcare benefits - extended health care, dental, vision, and life insurance

- High ownership and visibility across the company

- Work closely with experienced startup operators and leadership

- Top-notch team - You'll work with other top-tier talent, who have built large-scale enterprise SaaS products at top companies like Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, Confluent, Intuit, and more

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
First, What We’re Actually Doing
Fours is the end-to-end orchestration system for the fastest-growing sales channels: B2B marketplaces and ecosystems, powered by AI and integrations with the systems businesses already use.
Today, we work with 300+ amazing customers, ranging from leading AI companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, Decagon, and Glean to large enterprises like Snowflake, Workday, and Intel.
We’ve built a product customers love and a sales motion that works. Now, we need to build the organic growth engine that gets more of the right people discovering Fours, engaging with our content, and ultimately becoming customers.
As our Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll own our organic and owned marketing channels — from content and SEO to social and thought leadership. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who can develop the strategy, create the content, build distribution, and measure what works.
This is not a paid media or performance marketing role. We’re looking for someone who knows how to build organic growth that compounds over time.

What You'll Own (for real)
- Own organic growth: Develop and execute our strategy across SEO, organic social, content, email, and other owned channels.

- Build our content engine: Create and manage high-quality content including blog posts, thought leadership, customer stories, guides, newsletters, and social content.

- Own organic social: Build Fours’ presence and voice on LinkedIn and other relevant channels through compelling, differentiated content.

- Drive SEO: Identify and execute opportunities to increase organic traffic, search visibility, and inbound demand.

- Build distribution: Find creative ways to get our content and point of view in front of the right audiences through social media, communities, partnerships, executives, and other organic channels.

- Turn expertise into content: Work with founders, executives, Product, Sales, and customers to turn insights and expertise into content people actually want to consume and share.

- Measure and optimize: Track traffic, engagement, audience growth, inbound leads, and pipeline to understand what’s working and double down.

- Experiment: Test new channels, formats, and growth strategies and quickly figure out what works.
We're Looking For
- 4+ years of B2B growth, content, or organic marketing experience , ideally at an early-stage, high-growth SaaS or technology company.

- A track record of building organic channels from the ground up , particularly content, SEO, and/or organic social.

- Excellent writing, storytelling, and creative instincts with the ability to make complex B2B technology interesting and accessible.

- Strong understanding of SEO, content distribution, and organic growth .

- Highly hands-on and execution-oriented. You’re comfortable developing the strategy and doing the work yourself.

- Highly analytical and comfortable using data to understand what’s working and where to invest.

- Experience working with founders or executives on thought leadership and content is a strong plus.

- Experience with AI products, B2B SaaS, cloud marketplaces, partnerships, or ecosystem-led growth is a strong plus.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment without a large team or established playbook.

- High ownership, strong judgment, and a bias toward action.
Why Join Us
- Build our organic growth engine: Help define how Fours builds awareness, audience, and inbound demand without relying on paid acquisition.

- Help define our voice: Work directly with founders, executives, Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape how Fours tells its story.

- Build at an inflection point: Fours has strong product-market fit, 300+ customers, and a proven sales motion. Now you’ll help build the marketing engine to match.

- Work with an exceptional team: Join a driven team of ~75 people with experience at companies like Google, Meta, Salesforce, Asana, Confluent, and Square.

- Move fast and own your work: We value autonomy, good judgment, and getting things done over hierarchy and process.

- Competitive compensation: $130K–$180K/year base salary, plus meaningful equity, comprehensive health benefits, and monthly office stipends.
